purpose: Pre-registered, measurable acceptance criteria for S4 (point-in-time dataset builder). Committed BEFORE any S4 implementation or download. Thresholds are engineering/feasibility thresholds, not tuned to results.

scope.forbidden: any request, key, size, timestamp or byte of a month >= 2025-07 (includes listings, symbol metadata derived from later months, and the S1 coverage table, which carries post-cutoff last_month values and is NOT an input of the builder)
scope.no_performance: no returns, PnL, backtests, strategy signals or parameter selection of any kind

definitions.eligibility: asset-epoch eligible at date T if, using only COMPLETED daily candles (open+1d <= T) of the epoch, >= 60 of the 90 days before T exist and the median quote volume >= threshold; thresholds {1e6, 5e6}
definitions.epoch_break: a new identity epoch starts at the first candle after a coverage gap of >= 2 whole months, or at a daily close-to-close ratio >= 10 or <= 0.1; detected from candles up to and including that candle only; eligibility history never crosses an epoch boundary
definitions.classification: explicit table dataset/asset_classification.json is the only authority; name patterns are alarms only; a pattern-suspect base missing from the table is reported as classification_unreviewed and blocks the build
definitions.rate_limit: configured 30 requests/s (global token bucket); peak measured per 1-second window

gates.name: holdout boundary
gates.rule: request log contains 0 URLs/keys with month >= 2025-07 and 0 response keys >= 2025-07

gates.name: no post-cutoff influence on membership
gates.rule: adding/removing symbols or files that have only months >= 2025-07 changes no membership (synthetic + real-data perturbation)

gates.name: integrity
gates.rule: every downloaded file sha256 == published .CHECKSUM, else quarantined with checksum_mismatch after one refetch; unresolved fetch failures = 0

gates.name: resumability
gates.rule: a build interrupted at an arbitrary point and resumed yields the identical dataset hash as an uninterrupted build (synthetic transport with fault injection, plus one real interrupted run)

gates.name: rate limiting
gates.rule: measured peak request rate over any 1-second window <= 1.25 x configured limit

gates.name: complete hourly scan
gates.rule: every (candidate symbol, dev month) that has a daily file was requested for 1h and classified present/absent; unscanned = 0

gates.name: explicit reasons
gates.rule: every quarantined or absent-expected file carries a reason code from the closed set; unreasoned = 0

gates.name: detector completeness
gates.rule: each reason code produced by a synthetic file in tests

gates.name: identity epochs causal
gates.rule: epoch tables computed on data truncated at each of 8 seeded cutoffs equal the full-data table restricted to <= cutoff

gates.name: no future-dependent exclusion
gates.rule: membership at every seeded date T computed on data truncated at T equals membership from the full data (prefix invariance, real data, 12 seeded dates)

gates.name: classification
gates.rule: 100 % of candidate bases resolved by the explicit table; classification_unreviewed = 0

gates.name: causal liquidity
gates.rule: for 20 seeded dates, replacing every candle with open >= T by adversarial values (volume x1000, volume 0, deleted, duplicated files) leaves membership at T identical

gates.name: survivorship preserved
gates.rule: assets whose last candle is before 2025-06-01 appear as members at earlier dates (count > 0) and are not removed from past membership

gates.name: depth
gates.rule: >= 30 eligible epochs at 1 M USDT at every month start 2021-01..2025-06 using epoch + causal rules (no global exclusions)

gates.name: reproducibility
gates.rule: two independent builds from the same pinned raw files, one of them in a separate process, give identical dataset hash; archive stability: >= 99.9 % of S3-pinned daily files have the identical sha256 when re-downloaded

gates.name: manifest completeness
gates.rule: manifest lists every file (sha256, size, status/reason), code hash, criteria hash, classification hash and the dataset hash; recomputing the hash from the manifest reproduces it

report_only.name: cross-interval consistency
report_only.rule: share of symbol-months where daily volume equals the sum of hourly volume (relative tolerance 1e-6) and first/last candle dates agree

report_only.name: coverage
report_only.rule: symbols, epochs, files, quarantine counts by reason, identity events by type

report_only.name: licensing alternatives
report_only.rule: documentation only; verified permissions separated from unresolved legal questions

decision.NO_GO: any gate fails; failure documented, thresholds not changed after the fact
